messages:
Ava (AE): BetaBank procurement: must buy via AWS Marketplace SaaS and invoice must show Redwood as seller + our PO and their cost-center on each line.
Tom (BetaBank Procurement): Confirming. Also need our internal contract ref (CNTR-9933) and GL code per line. No direct invoices allowed.
Raj (Sales Eng): AWS can do Private Offers / Custom Contracts. Private Offer can attach a contract and negotiated price. Invoices still show AWS as biller usually, but private offers can surface seller metadata - need to confirm with AWS marketplace ops.
Marta (Finance): Note: if invoiced via AWS, cash collection and timing differ; revenue recognition requires copy of the underlying contract. Also VAT handling and tax ID must be on the invoice.
Ethan (Deal Desk): Deal desk: we can approve a 15% commit discount on a 12-month subscription if it fits ratecard. Need final ARR, SKU, and whether it's a subscription (monthly metered) or annual prepaid.
Sam (Marketplace Ops): AWS checklist: seller_id, offer_id, buyer_account_id, private_offer_payload, signed contract. AWS PO mapping: can include customer PO in marketplace billing details; per-line GL is not guaranteed.
Tom (BetaBank Procurement): Per-line GL mapping is mandatory for us. If AWS cannot provide it, procurement will not accept marketplace billing.
Marta (Finance): Possible workarounds: 1) Private Offer + contract addendum that has the GL mapping (we supply an invoice stub to procurement). 2) Or reseller/direct invoice (but procurement refuses it). We need to escalate to AWS if mapping is mandatory.
Lisa (Sales Ops): Timeline: preparing private offer + legal review ~5-7 business days. If we need AWS intervention for billing metadata, add 2-3 days. I’ll start the ticket with AWS support once we have signed pricing.
Ethan (Deal Desk): Action items: AE to confirm SKU & committed ARR; Marketplace Ops to draft private-offer payload; Finance to list invoice fields required; I’ll start approval queue.
Ava (AE): Committed: $180k ARR (12mo, $15k/mo), request 15% discount, NET45 payterm. I’ll upload customer PO and contract ref to the deal ticket now.
procurement-bot: checklist - seller_id, offer_id, buyer_account_id, customer_PO, contract_pdf, tax_id. docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/latest/userguide/private-SaaS-offers.html :memo:
Sam (Marketplace Ops): I’ll open an AWS support case to confirm whether per-line GL codes can be included or we must provide separately. tagging legal and finance.
Tom (BetaBank Procurement): thanks. if AWS won’t include GL per line, we’ll need a signed addendum that the finance team accepts as substitute for line items.
Marta (Finance): i can draft an invoice mapping addendum template. Legal to review contract language for GL/PO substitution.
Ethan (Deal Desk): queued. I’ll hold discount approval until addendum and AWS confirmation. If we can’t meet GL requirement, deal may need exec escalation.
Ava (AE): noted. will keep you posted. :thumbsup:
